statement.title: Breakthrough tools such as AI-powered analytics and predictive modeling, in the service of policy.
paragraphs: We use AI-powered data analytics and predictive modeling to inform policymaking, so that clients can anticipate trends, make better decisions and govern more effectively.

Technology only earns its place when the data, the institutions and the people around it are ready. That is where we start: with the data pipeline, the governance model and the evidence that a tool is worth adopting.

scene.title: From scattered signals to a system you can govern and trust.
scene.lead: Five layers of readiness, drawn as a network that finds its order as you scroll.

steps.label: Data
steps.title: Data pipelines and connected collection
steps.text: Automated data pipelines for efficiency and scale, and Internet of Things devices and digital reporting tools that improve data integrity, reduce reporting delays and drive operational efficiency.

steps.label: Analytics
steps.title: AI-powered analytics and predictive modeling
steps.text: Machine learning and AI-driven automation to improve data accuracy, sharpen trend forecasting and support timely decisions.
points: AI-driven tools and econometric models that quantify the success of interventions
Machine learning, AI and data-visualization tools

steps.label: Governance
steps.title: AI-driven governance models
steps.text: Artificial intelligence for predictive analysis, regulatory forecasting and operational efficiency, and automation of complex institutional workflows to improve responsiveness and reduce errors.

steps.label: Applications
steps.title: Emerging technology in public services
steps.text: Applications where sensing, automation and transparent records change how a service performs.
points: Smart utility platforms — IoT-enabled monitoring of utility service performance, energy efficiency and waste reduction
Blockchain-based platforms for transparent tracking of resource usage and payments
Precision agriculture — sensors, drones and AI that provide real-time data to optimize planting, watering and harvesting while conserving resources

steps.label: Adoption
steps.title: Platforms people use, evidence policy uses
steps.text: Cost-effective, interactive data platforms with stakeholder dashboards and performance tracking — and the evidence they generate put to use through better programs and policies.
points: Program learning integrated into policymaking for adaptive management
